'''Isabel Grevelt''' (born 11 April 2002) is a Dutch allround [[Speed skating|speed skater]].

==Career==
Grevelt won the 500 m gold medal at the [[Speed skating at the 2020 Winter Youth Olympics|2020 Winter Youth Olympics]] which took place at [[Lake St. Moritz]] in [[St. Moritz]], Switzerland .

On 30 October 2022 she qualified for the [[ISU Speed Skating World Cup]] series after finishing fifth at the 1000 m during the national qualification tournament. She made her World Cup debut in the 1000 m B-division at the [[Sørmarka Arena]] in Stavanger, Norway and won the race, resulting in a promotion to the A-division.<ref>{{cite web |title=ISU World Cup #1 – 1000m Women Division B |url=https://live.isuresults.eu/events/2023_NOR_0001/competition/17/results |publisher=International Skating Union (ISU)}}</ref> At the second World Cup event, held at the [[Thialf]] in Heerenveen, she finished in third place, behind [[Jutta Leerdam]] and [[Miho Takagi (speed skater)|Miho Takagi]], in a personal record of 1:14.54.<ref>{{cite web |title=ISU World Cup #2 – 1000m Women Division A |url=https://live.isuresults.eu/events/2023_NED_0001/competition/7/results |publisher=International Skating Union (ISU)}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author1=Lisanne van der Eijk |title=Isabel Grevelt verrassend derde: ‘Niet te verwoorden’ |url=https://www.schaatsen.nl/nieuws/2022/november/isabel-grevelt-verrassend-derde-niet-te-verwoorden/ |website=Schaatsen.nl |date=18 November 2022 |language=Dutch}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Netherlands dominate action in Heerenveen: Jutta Leerdam, Irene Schouten and Bart Hoolwerf all win gold |url=https://www.eurosport.com/speed-skating/heerenveen/2022-2023/netherlands-dominate-action-in-heerenveen-jutta-leerdam-irene-schouten-and-bart-hoolwerf-all-win-gol_sto9233967/story.shtml |publisher=Eurosport |date=19 November 2022}}</ref>
